2609.34345.title: CRISP: Cultural Reward Modeling for Implicit Situated Propriety
2609.34345.paper_summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across countries and regions, the ability to recognize and respond appropriately to diverse cultural contexts becomes increasingly important. However, existing research has largely focused on cultural knowledge or tasks with predefined response spaces, while open-ended culturally situated behavior remains comparatively underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRISP-RM, a culturally situated reward model that assigns rewards according to cultural appropriateness in open-ended social scenarios. During policy optimization, we further introduce Norm Grounding Supervision (NGS), providing guidance that enhances the policy's sensitivity to relevant cultural norms. To construct culturally situated data, we employ a collaborative multi-agent framework that instantiates implicit cultural norms into diverse social scenarios and further curate NormCompass as a dedicated testbed. We conduct comprehensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of CRISP-RM in both reward modeling and policy optimization. Best-of-\(N\) experiments show that CRISP-RM consistently outperforms strong general reward models. During GRPO policy optimization, CRISP-RM generally improves culturally situated behavior, while incorporating NGS yields further gains. Further analyses demonstrate the advantages of CRISP-RM in distinguishing culturally appropriate behavior beyond superficial fluency and politeness, while NGS provides complementary gains during policy optimization by improving norm grounding.
2609.34345.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）在各國和地區的日益部署，識別並適當回應多元文化背景的能力變得越來越重要。<lb/>然而，現有研究主要集中在文化知識或具有預定回應空間的任務上，而開放式的文化情境行為則相對未被充分探索。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了CRISP-RM，一種文化情境獎勵模型，根據開放式社交場景中的文化適當性分配獎勵。<lb/>在政策優化過程中，我們進一步引入了規範基礎監督（NGS），提供指導以增強政策對相關文化規範的敏感性。<lb/>為了構建文化情境數據，我們採用了一種協作多代理框架，將隱含的文化規範實體化到多樣的社交場景中，並進一步策劃NormCompass作為專門的測試平台。<lb/>我們進行了全面的實驗，以評估CRISP-RM在獎勵建模和政策優化中的有效性。<lb/>最佳的\(N\)實驗顯示，CRISP-RM始終優於強大的通用獎勵模型。<lb/>在GRPO政策優化過程中，CRISP-RM通常改善了文化情境行為，而納入NGS則帶來了進一步的增益。<lb/>進一步的分析顯示，CRISP-RM在區分文化適當行為方面的優勢超越了表面的流利度和禮貌，而NGS在政策優化過程中通過改善規範基礎提供了互補的增益。
